title: ContentUnit
description: A single discrete piece of derivative content generated from an episode for distribution across platforms. Examples: a 90-second clip, a social caption, a newsletter excerpt, a YouTube chapter card, a transcript quote card. ContentUnits are generated by the content engine and require human approval before distribution. They are never generated or dispatched without an approved parent Episode.

content_unit_id.description: Stable UUID for this content unit.

episode_id.description: The Episode this content unit is derived from.

asset_id.description: The source Asset this unit was generated from (e.g. the clip's parent master).

status.description: Current status. Only approved units may be scheduled or published.

body.description: Text content of the unit (caption, excerpt, script). Stored inline only for short-form text units.

asset_reference.description: asset_id or storage_uri of the media file for clip or graphic units.

scheduled_at.description: When this unit is scheduled to publish.
